title: Polyhedral Global Newton–Okounkov Bodies for Mori Dream Spaces
literature_status: Prior affirmative flag-on-X theorem statements and a later attribution are verified. Their exact proof is not independently certified here. This is not a current-open designation, a disproof of the prior conclusion, or a novelty claim.
proof_claims: Smooth-conic failure of a general coordinate-projection inference despite surjective restriction
Birational isomorphism-locus descent criterion and global-cone slice equality
Exact plane-cubic flag semigroup on P^2 with rational-polyhedral global cone but no finite semigroup generation
Associated-graded generation is a sufficient condition for semigroup and cone finite generation
nonclaims: The smooth conic is not claimed to satisfy every hypothesis of the special Cox/tropical construction
No counterexample to the universal existence question
No proof that the earlier announced conclusion is false
No assertion that absence of a later correction or journal record settles manuscript status
mathematical_validation: Independent proof review accepts Propositions 3.1, 4.1 and 5.1, and Proposition 6.1 with its explicit full numerical-lattice hypothesis. Source-construction applicability remains uncertified.
corrections: Recognize first-boundary indexing as supported by PU Section 5.1.1, while recording the printed m−n+i inconsistency
